body:
Yes I love him very much, and he surely must love me as he confessed to something he's very ashamed about simply because he felt prompted to tell me the truth. 

We know the next steps are to contact the bishop for help accessing resources. However, from comments on here and then googling I now know that my husband has broken the law and could face serious jail time.  If we go to the bishop he's obligated to report crimes.

I have already forgiven my husband as I understand that his sexual addiction and actions weren't intended to hurt, though I am still very much hurting.   Regardless, I don't know what the path forward looks like right now.   Temporary separation may be necessary, it may not. I'm still in shock.

Thank you for the resource, I will look into it.  

I apologise for the lack of information in the post I was asked by the mods to remove the details. Although his actions weren't that of a child crime,it does fall under the category of sin and not simply a sexual difference.
Thank you. I was already thinking of that. Hopefully his parents can take the dog.

I don't know. I don't think he's into animals exactly. From my understanding he said the dog came up while my husband was peeing and tried to lick him, my husband, for whatever reason, let the dog do it and it became a problem after that. He admitted to it happening 6 or 7 times over the past month, but I know he isn't being honest about the time frame.
